cat=json.loads(pathlib.Path(ext[0]['path']).read_text())
print('catalogType',type(cat).__name__,list(cat) if isinstance(cat,dict) else len(cat))
orig=json.loads((Q/'original-leaf-bindings.json').read_text());ids={e['id'] for e in orig}
with pathlib.Path(ext[1]['path']).open() as f:

  if r.get('owner_task')=='P100-024': rows.append(r)
